title: Write in the cloud. Render at home.
description: A 6-second kinetic-type motion graphic drawn on an HTML canvas, comparing a cloud sandbox render with a local one.

requires.why: headless browser that draws the frames (Chrome, Edge or Chromium)
reads the finished video for the report

render.engine_command: node runtime/capture.mjs --entry src/index.html --width 1920 --height 1080 --fps 30 --frames 180 && ffmpeg -i .lr-work/frames/frame_%06d.png <fastest encoder> write-in-the-cloud.mp4
